sum.m: a mark: Latin signum; in verbs, signāre, to mark
a connecting vowel, joining a base to an ending that starts with a consonant
that makes or causes: Latin -ficus, from facere, to make
describes what something is like or does, as -ent does: pleasant, important

mean: that makes a sign: full of meaning, important
